title: Mall World Cops
content: Has anyone ever been chased by “police” in Mall World? More recently, I’ve been dreaming of military/police/hybrid human-robots chasing after me if I venture too deep into Mall World (like the dark backroads leading to military camps). They & regular Mall World people usually chase after me once I become too lucid. I usually don’t say things like, “what time/day is it?” But they notice when I start panicking realizing that I’m stuck in the mall. Then there were a few dreams where I’d fight/argue with someone in front of a fancy restaurant & the employees would call the cops. This restaurant is next door to a hotel on a busy strip that sort of reminds me of Vegas; casinos, shops, hotels, except this strip is more compacted.
